h: Korach and the Danger of Trusting Every Inner Counsel

p: it says none of these, but 'And he took.'
'What has your heart taken you, etc.'"
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 176a)
He took evil counsel for himself, etc."
But the whole verse is superfluous,
"and men of the Children of Yisrael, etc."
and this is what it says,
as they said in Midrash Rabbah
and among the bearers of the Aron, etc."
it is stated in Midrash Rabbah
אֲשֶׁר יַחְדָּיו נַמְתִּיק סוֹד (תְּהִלִּים נה, טו)
וְאֶת כׇּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי וְגוֹמֵר
and all your brothers the sons of Levi, etc.";
and it is stated in Midrash Rabbah
his brothers became secondary to him, etc."
And the Ramban, of blessed memory, already wrote
that there were in the tribe of the servants of our God
two hundred and fifty summoned men and princes,
and against the greatest among them,
וְאֶת כׇּל אַחֶיךָ בְנֵי לֵוִי וְגוֹמֵר
and all your brothers the sons of Levi, etc.,"
for the members of his tribe were
because they were brothers to him.
that he was a complete tzaddik,
וּכְבָר לִבּוֹ חָלַל בְּקִרְבּוֹ (תְּהִלִּים קט, כב)
and already "his heart was hollow within him" (Tehillim 109:22),
and the yetzer hara had been cleared out of his heart.
And it is stated in the Midrash
יְמַלֵּא ה׳ כׇּל מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶיךָ (תְּהִלִּים כ, ו)
one does not pray for every person,
whose heart is whole before his Creator
"And may He fulfill all your counsel."
that his heart was whole before his Creator,
that certainly it was Hashem's counsel,
and that this is how it must be.
And this is what it says, "And Korach took":
and the counsel of his heart misled him
that as long as evil has existence
among the nations of the world,
that it is the counsel of the yetzer hara;
and there the yetzer hara was able
And so too at Mattan Torah,
that they would not have died
he is the Angel of Death,
the yetzer hara ruled over them.

"And they rose up before Moshe, etc." (Bamidbar 16:2).
and two hundred and fifty men
gathered against Moshe and Aharon, etc."
And in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 176b):
this verse the companions have explained."
that it refers to what they expounded
and regarding Golyas the Pelishti is said
And this is what it says,
that they rose with upright stature
for certainly they did not deny
of speaking out of personal interest.
And since it arose so in his heart,
he thought that it was Hashem's counsel.
And in truth, regarding Shabbos it is written
and He will give you the requests of your heart";
"You must say, this is the delight of Shabbos."
For regarding Shabbos it is stated
fortunate is he who makes for them
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there."
And then the heart will want
and this is what it says:
"And He will give you the requests of your heart."
